nodes.label: Default pmm Kubernetes Namespace in the K8sHelper Constructor
nodes.rationale: The namespace is hardcoded to pmm in the K8sHelper constructor rather than read from configuration; overriding it means editing that constructor or passing a namespace explicitly.
nodes.norm_label: default pmm kubernetes namespace in the k8shelper constructor

nodes.label: Tests Never Self-Skip on an Unreachable HA Cluster
nodes.rationale: Nothing skips itself: an unreachable namespace fails the test with kubectl’s own error, so a missing HA cluster surfaces as a visible failure with the underlying kubectl message instead of a silently skipped test.
nodes.norm_label: tests never self-skip on an unreachable ha cluster
